title: Independent Re-Derivation Records
body:

Every record in this database follows that same discipline, so the archive stays consistent as it grows.

Method. The working method for this record is Independent re-derivation and cross-checking, applied within verification. First, the question is written down in one sentence so its scope is clear. Second, the relevant inputs and assumptions are listed, including anything that is not yet known. Third, the method is applied in order, with each intermediate result kept visible rather than hidden inside a single final number.
